message.content:
The title of “best player in soccer today” is highly debated and depends on the criteria you value—goals, assists, influence on the game, trophies, or overall skill. As of mid‑2026, the most frequently cited names are:

| Player | Nationality | Club (2025‑26) | Key Strengths |
|--------|-------------|----------------|---------------|
| **Lionel Messi** | Argentina | Inter Miami (MLS) | Vision, dribbling, play‑making, longevity |
| **Kylian Mbappé** | France | Paris Saint‑Germain | Pace, finishing, work rate |
| **Erling Haaland** | Norway | Manchester City | Physicality, positioning, goal‑scoring consistency |
| **Kevin De Bruyne** | Belgium | Manchester City | Passing range, tactical awareness, set‑piece delivery |
| **Neymar Jr.** | Brazil | Al‑Hilal (Saudi Pro League) | Flair, creativity, versatility |

If you’re looking at pure statistical output (goals + assists) for the 2025‑26 season, **Erling Haaland** topped the charts with 38 goals and 12 assists in the Premier League. In terms of overall influence on team success, **Kevin De Bruyne** has been pivotal for Manchester City’s domestic and European campaigns.

Ultimately, the “best” player is a matter of personal preference and the specific aspects of the game you value most.
